answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
